title: Portable status, doctor and reminders report ownership and unresolved recovery
outcome: Deferred first-version portable status and recovery guidance; detach and forced takeover remain later-scope decisions preserved on the later-stage item.
acceptance: `engram portable status [--json]`, the `doctor` block and one `next` reminder line show the mode, lineage, epoch, writer state, the last validation with its result and how much of its age is left, an unresolved intent, and the target's off-host text as the backup brief defines it; a test drives the store through `configuring`, `active`, `releasing`, `released`, `acquiring`, superseded and unverified and asserts that each is shown and that none is shown as `local`
`next` adds its reminder only when the store is frozen or the validation is close to its age, and adds nothing for a `local` project; tests cover the cases

Status distinguishes backup freshness from current writer ownership and separates historical publication from current activation. Tests cover a published ancestor, unresolved dispatch, installed-but-journal-incomplete state, absent registration and cancelled preparation; none implies writable local fallback.

The first-version CLI has no detach or forced takeover command. Help and docs explain clean release is required for pull, lost-host recovery remains separate, and no automatic scheduling ships. docs/shipped.md is updated only for demonstrated commands. Help explicitly states offline startup/resume blocks portable writes until fresh remote validation, and lost active-host backup restore offers only read-only inspection with no writable v1 recovery, takeover or new-lineage fork. Returning pull leaves prior private scratch only in the frozen archive. Terminal losing acquisition is distinct from unresolved dispatch and permits read-only access without writer admission.
disposal_reason: Portable handoff was replaced before any of it shipped: docs/features/git-task-sync.md says the previous portable writer-epoch and release/acquire design is gone, AGENTS.md says the selected sync uses no global writer lock, writer epochs or release/acquire protocol, and master has no portable code or brief. Cancelled under Greg's word, 43498a6e #683. Nothing here was built or tested.
